blurb: The Great Reno Balloon Race is a weather-driven event held at Rancho San Rafael Regional Park featuring mass ascension launches, tethering activities, and a tissue paper balloon launch. Spectators can enjoy early morning balloon events, shopping along Balloon Boulevard, and VIP Club access. The event is free to spectators and supported by sponsors.
